name: Copernicus Data Space
description: Search, process, and analyze free Copernicus Sentinel satellite imagery through the Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem APIs

credential_fields.name: client_id
credential_fields.label: OAuth Client ID
credential_fields.description: Client ID created in the Copernicus Data Space Sentinel Hub dashboard

credential_fields.name: client_secret
credential_fields.label: OAuth Client Secret
credential_fields.description: Client secret created with the Copernicus Data Space OAuth client

tools.name: list_sentinel_collections
tools.description: List Sentinel and other Earth-observation collections available through the Sentinel Hub catalog

tools.name: get_sentinel_collection
tools.description: Get metadata, spatial extent, temporal extent, and links for one Sentinel Hub data collection

collection_id.description: Collection identifier such as sentinel-2-l2a or sentinel-1-grd

tools.name: search_sentinel_imagery
tools.description: Search Sentinel imagery by collection, bounding box or geometry, acquisition time, cloud cover, and other STAC filters

collections.description: Collection IDs to search, for example sentinel-2-l2a or sentinel-1-grd

bbox.description: WGS84 bounding box [west, south, east, north]

datetime.description: RFC 3339 instant or interval, for example 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z/2026-02-01T00:00:00Z

filter.description: STAC CQL2 JSON filter, for example an eo:cloud_cover comparison

tools.name: process_sentinel_image
tools.description: Render or download a Sentinel image for an area and time range using Sentinel Hub Process API and an evalscript

input.description: Process API input containing bounds and a data array with collection type and timeRange

output.description: Output dimensions or resolution and response format definitions

evalscript.description: Sentinel Hub Evalscript V3 defining input bands and rendered output

tools.name: calculate_sentinel_statistics
tools.description: Calculate band statistics, histograms, or spectral-index time series over an area without downloading full imagery

input.description: Statistics input data definition and time range

aggregation.description: Time interval, resolution, and evalscript aggregation definition

calculations.description: Optional histogram and percentile calculations by output band

tools.name: list_cdse_stac_collections
tools.description: List product collections in the broader Copernicus Data Space STAC 1.1 catalog

tools.name: search_cdse_products
tools.description: Search the broader Copernicus Data Space STAC product catalog using STAC 1.1 spatial, temporal, and collection filters

filter.description: CQL2 JSON object or text filter
